items.source: Return the CacheResolver instance to use to resolve the cache to use for this operation.
items.translation: 返回要用于解析此操作所用缓存的CacheResolver实例。

items.source:
A cache operation can be statically cached as it does not contain any
runtime operation of a specific cache invocation.
items.translation: 缓存操作可以静态缓存，因为它不包含特定缓存调用的任何运行时操作。

items.source: The method arguments must match the signature of the related method invocation
items.translation: 方法参数必须与相关方法调用的签名匹配。

items.source: A - the type of the JSR-107 annotation
values - the parameters value for a particular invocation
Return the CacheInvocationParameter instances based on the specified method arguments.
items.translation: 返回基于指定方法参数的CacheInvocationParameter实例。
